title: Read-only suppressed focus-outline findings
description:
# Read-only suppressed focus-outline findings

Next slice of LIM-e872b1. Extends `limatus usability scan` only.

## DoD

- Same CLI. New kind: `suppressed_focus_outline`.
- Profile: `focus.flagSuppressedOutline` boolean, default **true**. Unknown keys rejected. Contrast + tapTarget must keep loading.
- Interactive set: same as tap-targets (`a`, `button`, non-hidden `input`, `select`, `textarea`, `summary`, `role=button|link`).
- Extend the existing simple stylesheet parser to accept **one** trailing pseudo on simple selectors: `tag:focus`, `.class:focus`, `#id:focus` (also `:focus-visible` treated the same). No combinators, no `*`.
- Flag when the **focus** rule (or the element’s own inline `outline`) resolves to `none`, `0`, or `0px` / `outline-width: 0`.
- Skip if that same winning declaration block also sets `box-shadow` to a value other than `none` (custom ring). If box-shadow is absent or `none`, flag.
- Element-level `outline: none` without a `:focus` rule still flags (inline or non-pseudo rule matching the element).
- JSON: `id`, `kind`, `selector`, `rationale`. No rewrite keys. Other kinds unchanged.
- Tests: `button:focus { outline: none }` flags; `button:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000 }` does not; unsized page / existing fixtures do not gain this kind; tempfile for extra profiles.
- `PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -q`

## Out of scope

- Full cascade, `:focus-within`, keyboard vs mouse, tap-target/contrast regressions
- SKILL.md, decide/apply, live URLs

## Layout

- Worktree: `/tmp/limatus-e872b1-focus-outline` from `origin/main`
- Branch: `feat/LIM-<this-id>-usability-focus-outline`
- PR target: **main**

## Inversion

- Do not flag a custom box-shadow focus ring.
- Do not invent focus styles when no outline rule is present (missing :focus is not this slice — only **suppressed** outline).
